_doc.classes: The five corpus classes (SPEC 5.1); a decision takes exactly one.
_doc.boundary_categories: The two boundary categories, delete and merge; a boundary case must name one.
_doc.tools: shell and edit are tool names compared exactly with the payload tool_name; claude_matcher is the Claude PreToolUse matcher regex.
_doc.shells: Interpreter names compared with the basename of the first word after wrapper unwrapping; a heredoc consumed by one of them is classified as a script.
_doc.shell_value_flags: Shell options that take a value; skipped, with their value, while looking for the -c payload.
_doc.wrappers: Command wrappers and runners (A5 rule 6c), matched by the basename of the first word, unwrapped repeatedly; each list holds the options that take a value, long options also as --name=value and short options also with the value attached. xargs, doas, stdbuf, watch and flock are runners: xargs, doas and stdbuf unwrap like the others; watch without -x or --exec turns its remaining words into a shell string; flock skips its options and the lock file, and a -c or --command value becomes a shell string.
_doc.runners: attached_value_flags: per runner, options whose value can only be attached (xargs -i -l -e, watch -d), never the next word; watch_exec_flags: watch options after which the remaining words are an argv, not a shell string; flock_command_flags: flock options whose value is a shell string; find_exec_actions: find actions whose words up to a terminating ; or {} + are classified as a command.
_doc.git: Option sets compared with the words after the git verb: global_value_options only before the verb; clean, push and commit value options inside that verb; the other lists are matched against the verb or its first argument.
_doc.release: gh pairs are compared with words[1:3]; az_requires words may appear anywhere in the az words; az_pr_update is the prefix words[1:4] plus the word completed anywhere; package_tools with package_verb anywhere after the tool name; deploy_words anywhere after the tool name of a deploy_tools entry.
_doc.boundary: delete_commands match the basename of the first word; find_delete_flag anywhere after find; gh pairs are compared with words[1:3].
_doc.protected: harness_dirs match path components, and only the path part right after the directory is checked against files and agents_prefixes; component matches any path component; state_root_exceptions are file names at the state directory root only.
_doc.marker: fresh_ms is the heartbeat window for the mod liveness marker; session_id_pattern is the only session id form that is looked up.
